ServerFeatureInteropTests.ConditionRefre.reason: open62541 1.5.8 has no ConditionRefresh without the EXPERIMENTAL UA_ENABLE_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ALARMS_CONDITIONS build option, and even with it the method callback is only attached when the first condition is created (setConditionMethodCallbacks, src/server/ua_subscription_alarms_conditions.c:2369/2391); the ConditionType.ConditionRefresh (i=3875) node of namespace 0 has no callback, so the Call returns Bad_InternalError (src/server/ua_services_method.c:156) instead of RefreshStart/RefreshEnd events (OPC 10000-9 5.5.7) or Bad_NotImplemented
ServerFeatureInteropTests.ConditionRefre.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/open62541/open62541/issues

LegacyServerInteropTests.ValueAboveServe.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/open62541/open62541/issues

EccInteropTests.ClientToLegacyServerAsyn.reason: open62541 1.5.8 derives the encryption key and IV also for MessageSecurityMode Sign and counts them in L of the HKDF salt (ua_securechannel_crypto.c generateLocalKeys/RemoteKeys); OPC 10000-6 6.8.1 sets EncryptionKeyLength and InitializationVectorLength to 0 for Sign only without AuthenticatedEncryption, as the .NET stacks do, so the first signed message fails with Bad_SecurityChecksFailed (with the OpenSSL backend the open62541 side reports Bad_InternalError, because UA_OpenSSL_HMAC_SHA256_Verify, plugins/crypto/openssl/securitypolicy_common.c:704, maps an HMAC mismatch to Bad_InternalError); the AEAD policies (ECC_nistP256_AesGcm/_ChaChaPoly) derive the keys for Sign as well and are not affected
EccInteropTests.ClientToLegacyServerAsyn.issue: upstream issue to be filed at https://github.com/open62541/open62541/issues
